description: Puts an earlier version of the app online again: it becomes the newest version (nothing is lost, the history is kept) and is published. app_status lists the versions (commit, date, message). Use it when the latest version broke something. Confirm with the user first.

commit.description: commit of the version, from app_status

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

name: restore_version
title: Go back to an earlier version
